main_text.l: potius quam specie differre: revera ta-
men intrinsecè, formaliter, & specificè
ad invicem distinguuntur. Verum est i-
lla distinctio, ob affinitatem, & finis in
quem tenduntur, & vocum quibus expri-
muntur,adeo fæpę obscura, ut difficile
sit tria ista aut non penitus confundere, aut
dextrè & peritè distinguere. Itaque quo
melius isthæc internoscantur, quatuor
mihi videntur esse confideranda, ex qui-
bus velut criteriis de qualibet loquendi
formulâ sitne Juramentum, an-Obte-
statio, an Asseveratio tantùm, poterimus
aliquatenus dijudicare. Forma sc. ver-
borum, eorundem propria & genuinâ[?]
vis, Mos gentis, & Intentio ipsius ju-
rantis.
SECT. V.
Primo, ex ipsa verborum formâ quan-
doque satis constare poterit, utrum ju-
ratum sit, vel non. Juro mihi te daturum
centum. Juro: vel per Deum dabo: vel
Deo teste aut coram Deo spondeo me dat-
urum: vel Dabo, ita me Deus adjuvet
aut aliquid simile si respondeatur, quia
juratam sit nemini potest esse dubium.
Obligatur proinde, qui istiusmodi aliqu[?]

page.notes: The right edge of every line is cut off by the scan, so line-final words are incomplete and the last letters of several lines are unreadable; they are not marked individually. Doubtful: "genuinâ" (edge-cropped), "aliqu" (edge-cropped, probably aliquid), "quia" (edge-cropped). "Cafus 35" is a left margin note, printed as such (probably Casus). The hyphenated "an-Obte-statio" keeps the printed hyphens. The printed page carries no foot note.
